title: ArtWork at Open Source Village
description:
Open Call for a min of 2 Artists and max of 4, collaboratively and autonomously working on 1 Artwork, either a visualization or a performance that runs through a wide range in either variation within the following domains: Citizen participation, FOSDEM participants , and open source code influence. 

Showcase your final project in the public space or at the Commons Hub.

Exchange: 
Covers free entry of the full event, and a worktable. 
This residency does not include accommodation.  
And travel costs are not included.
milestones: Succesful event launch of the artwork.
Harmonious and efficient coordination between the group.
externalFormInstructions: Your external application form must include the Pilgrim wallet address and/or the pseudonym displayed on Hubs Network, so that the Hub can match the form response to the on-chain Passport application.
